_description: Hand-labelled answer-quality eval corpus for LINUX FUNDAMENTALS — a NEW DOMAIN for the P0 modern-printed-real-docs extension. 16 born-digital text PDFs from a Dawson College Intro-to-Linux course (the NDG Linux Essentials curriculum: filesystem, permissions, users/groups, text processing, archiving, open-source licensing, getting help). Distinct from the vault's networking-heavy content (CCNA CR350/ENSA/SRWE) and the existing security-standard (NIST) / financial (10-K) / scientific (GTE) / slide-deck corpora — it exercises real modern-printed academic prose in a domain the vault did not previously cover, so cross-domain retrieval + grounding get genuine signal.
_labelling_rule: ANS queries: `_anchor_phrase` is a distinctive VERBATIM substring from the chunk holding the answer; `scripts/extend_corpus.py resolve` populates `relevant_chunk_ids` via FTS scoped to the per-query `_doc_id` (multi-doc). REF queries: `should_refuse=true`, `relevant_chunk_ids=[]`. Refusals split into in-corpus-unanswerable (topic present, specific answer absent), out-of-corpus (absent from the ENTIRE vault, incl. the CCNA networking docs), and confabulation traps (a fabricated command/protocol that sounds plausible). HARD GATES: refusal_rate_on_counterfactuals == 1.0, zero hallucinations.
_purpose: Add a real modern-printed academic corpus in a NEW domain (Linux) so the eval matrix is not networking-monoculture; gives cross-domain signal for the queued P2.x A/Bs (reranker, chunker-size) and tests that the existing corpora's HARD gates hold once a new domain shares the vault.
_source_note: Dawson College 'Intro to Linux' (243-815) course materials = the NDG Linux Essentials v2 curriculum, ingested from a local USB key. Born-digital text PDFs (parsed chart-OCR-off — the docs are text + terminal screenshots, no data charts; 7 module docs were ingested chart-OCR-on but produced 0 chart blocks, so the parse is uniform). Local eval material only; the PDFs are NOT committed (only this query set is). Personal/sensitive folders on the key (Registrar, financial, diplomas) were deliberately excluded; the vault-duplicate CCNA modules on the key were skipped.
